No suspicious commands, obfuscation, unexpected network calls, or data exfiltration patterns are present. The only notable observation is a missing trailing slash in the source filename pattern (`linux-x64.tar.gz` instead of `linux-x64/.tar.gz`), which is a trivial cosmetic issue rather than a security concern.
</details>
